correctness.rationale: TARGET proof checked stepwise. Step 1 hereditary permanence (simplicity, nuclearity, finiteness via same Murray-von Neumann relations, non-elementary via no finite-dimensional hereditary subalgebra, nonzero densely defined traces from a in Ped(A), strict comparison via stable isomorphism, stable rank one via Rieffel) is standard. Step 2 invokes resolved Toms-Winter plus non-unital extension as disclosed black boxes to get B Z-stable with CPoU. Step 3 uses nuclearity to get injective hence hyperfinite GNS fibers by Connes, finite-dimensional 2-norm approximants, Winter-Zacharias/Loring lift to cpc order-zero maps extended to weak* neighborhoods over the a-normalized compact trace base. Step 4 glues finitely many local maps via CPoU centrality/orthogonality into one order-zero map, promoted by Kirchberg epsilon-test and converted to a cone homomorphism. No computation; reliance honestly disclosed; no essential inference break or boundary error found. This is proof, not experimental evidence.
